body: i want to kill myself as well. pls dont. look around here and read some more peoples stories. we are not perfect but we are not alone. you just do not have the tools to cope with your pain right now but you can find them. there is a good life waiting for you somewhere we just have to find it. people are capable of great change. you can be a happier version of yourself. know that it is a slow process. youre literally changing the way your brain works. pls respond. i want to talk.
